title: 第491章 狂刀爆火龙
slug: 天赋太差全凭系统黑化
content_zh:
悲愤至极的欧阳庄主瞬间暴走，可怕的道法攻击不断轰在林雲的身上。
虚空中，林雲与欧阳庄主的身影化为两道圣光，在不断交锋之中。可怕的威压不断从虚空中炸开，一道道罡气风暴不断的肆虐。
欧阳庄主的速度奇快无比，未等林雲身形稳定就已经杀到林雲的身前。狂暴的攻击融入大道神威灵力之中，整个欧阳山庄上空在这种可怕的神威之下，竟不断的颤动。
虽然林雲多次被欧阳庄主的攻击轰飞出去，幸好有六道武境血脉之力的加持护体，让林雲并没有受到重创。
面对欧阳庄主的再度杀来，林雲迅速稳定神体气息，红色熔岩气息瞬间从林雲神体之上爆发出来，“熔岩火焰神功，岩浆火焰龙！”
林雲朝着欧阳庄主杀来的方向，猛然释放出岩浆火焰龙之技。岩浆火焰龙乃是岩浆火焰神功三重技的第一技能。
可怕的岩浆火焰龙携带岩浆的恐怖高温之力，不仅可以利用高温岩浆对敌人进行重创，而且还能够以火焰道则之威来冲击对手。
恐怖的岩浆火焰龙瞬间杀向欧阳庄主，一道道熔岩高温火焰凝聚成一尊火焰神龙，两人的战场上当即被高温熔岩火焰烧出一道道焦黑的痕迹。
欧阳庄主见状，大手冲着岩浆火焰神龙挥出，圣境道则之力化为一道狂刀劈向岩浆火焰龙。
狂刀直接卷动空间风暴径直劈杀而下，金色狂刀刀锋破开虚空，天穹风云一分为二，一道巨大的沟壑赫然出现的苍穹之上。
岩浆火焰龙爆发出高温熔岩，将半个苍穹都染成火焰红，漫天的风云被火焰覆盖。
欧阳山庄的众人望着虚空中两道狂暴的攻击，各个惊骇得话都说不出来！金光狂刀与岩浆火焰龙朝着彼此杀去，狂暴的能量轰在一起！
金色狂刀以恐怖的神威杀入高温熔岩火焰龙之中，狂暴的金色神威从高温熔岩中炸裂，一道道金光见熔岩火焰龙炸裂开。
content_en:
The owner of Ouyang Village, who was extremely sad and angry, immediately went berserk, and terrible Taoist attacks continued to bombard Lin Yun's body.
In the void, the figures of Lin Yun and Master Ouyang turned into two rays of holy light, and they were constantly fighting. Terrible coercion continued to explode from the void, and a series of strong energy storms continued to rage.
Master Ouyang's speed was extremely fast, and he had already reached Lin Yun before he could stabilize his body. The violent attack was integrated into the spiritual power of the great power of the avenue, and the entire sky above Ouyang Villa was trembling continuously under this terrifying power.
Although Lin Yun was blown away by the attacks of Master Ouyang many times, fortunately, with the blessing and protection of the bloodline of the Six Martial Realm, Lin Yun was not seriously injured.
Facing Master Ouyang's attack again, Lin Yun quickly stabilized his divine body's aura, and the red lava aura instantly burst out from Lin Yun's divine body, "Lava Flame Divine Art, Magma Flame Dragon!"
Lin Yun suddenly released the magma flame dragon technique in the direction where Master Ouyang was coming. Magma Flame Dragon is the first skill of the three-level magma flame magic skill.
The terrifying magma flame dragon carries the terrifying high-temperature power of magma. It can not only use the high-temperature magma to inflict heavy damage on the enemy, but can also impact the opponent with the power of the law of fire.
The terrifying magma flame dragon instantly killed Master Ouyang. The high-temperature flames of the lava condensed into a flame dragon. The battlefield between the two was immediately burned with black marks by the high-temperature lava flames.
Seeing this, Master Ouyang swung his big hand at the magma flame dragon, and the power of the holy realm's principles turned into a mad knife and struck at the magma flame dragon.
The mad sword directly rolled up the space storm and slashed down. The golden mad sword blade broke through the void, the sky was divided into two, and a huge gully appeared in the sky.
The magma flame dragon erupted into high-temperature lava, dyeing half of the sky red with flames, and the wind and clouds in the sky were covered in flames.
Everyone in Ouyang Villa looked at the two violent attacks in the void, and everyone was so horrified that they couldn't speak! The golden mad sword and the magma flame dragon were killing each other, and the violent energy blasted together!
The golden mad sword struck into the high-temperature lava flame dragon with terrifying divine power. The violent golden divine power exploded from the high-temperature lava, and streaks of golden light saw the lava flame dragon explode.
